bio: With this culinary hotspot located in the chic boutique hotel Legend, Daniel Gottschlich (known from Ox & Klee) has another restaurant concept to his name in the cathedral city. The vibe here is lively, modern and urban. You can dine at the bar, at one of the high tables or at a regular table. In summer, there is the gorgeous terrace. Johannes Langenstück's kitchen team serves up bar food as well as dishes for sharing – also available in individual portions. Or would you prefer the surprise menu Chefs Choice? Decent wine list and an appealing cocktail selection including their Signature drinks....
